business_summary.text: Quess Corp Limited is India's largest staffing and workforce solutions company, providing general staffing, professional IT staffing, and overseas workforce solutions.

lab.quote: As far as the guidance is concerned, it would be safe to say that we would continue to remain and measure ourselves in the 11-12% margin category for the medium term as well.

call_memory.quote: As far as the guidance is concerned, it would be safe to say that we would continue to remain and measure ourselves in the 11-12% margin category for the medium term as well.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management expects Professional Staffing to sustain margins in the 11% to 12% category for the medium term.

lab.quote: And we feel that this year, we will be able to come back on a 10% to 11% headcount growth and 12% to 13% revenue growth.

call_memory.quote: And we feel that this year, we will be able to come back on a 10% to 11% headcount growth and 12% to 13% revenue growth.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management expects Professional Staffing to deliver 10% to 11% headcount growth and 12% to 13% revenue growth in FY27.

lab.quote: So, it would be safe to say that in an immediate term, a (+2%) margin in a medium-term going towards a 2.4%.

call_memory.quote: So, it would be safe to say that in an immediate term, a (+2%) margin in a medium-term going towards a 2.4%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management expects overall EBITDA margin to be 2%+ in the immediate term and move towards 2.4% over a medium-term three-year period.

lab.quote: We would continue to keep working ourselves towards a (+6%) margin as far as our international mix and book is concerned.

call_memory.quote: We would continue to keep working ourselves towards a (+6%) margin as far as our international mix and book is concerned.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management targets maintaining a greater than 6% blended EBITDA margin for the international business mix.

lab.quote: If I were to moderate the one-time pass-through out of the INR 42 crore revenue jump during this quarter, about INR 10 crores is the one-time.

call_memory.quote: If I were to moderate the one-time pass-through out of the INR 42 crore revenue jump during this quarter, about INR 10 crores is the one-time.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Out of the INR 42 crore revenue increase in Overseas business in Q4 FY26, about INR 10 crores was due to one-time pass-through.

lab.quote: For the year FY26, we added approximately 26,000 net-add in our headcount in the Staffing Solutions business.

call_memory.quote: For the year FY26, we added approximately 26,000 net-add in our headcount in the Staffing Solutions business.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Net additions to employment in General Staffing were 26,000 for FY26.

lab.quote: GCCs continue to account for 71% of total headcount deployment in our Professional Staffing business, reflecting our strategic position in high-value niche roles and segments.

call_memory.quote: GCCs continue to account for 71% of total headcount deployment in our Professional Staffing business, reflecting our strategic position in high-value niche roles and segments.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: GCCs account for 71% of total headcount deployment in the Professional Staffing business.

lab.quote: Second, we have pivoted ourselves to GCCs and today our book is almost 71% built on the back of GCCs followed by another 20% on IT customers within enterprises followed by 9-10% only from the IT services pack.

call_memory.quote: Second, we have pivoted ourselves to GCCs and today our book is almost 71% built on the back of GCCs followed by another 20% on IT customers within enterprises followed by 9-10% only from the IT services pack.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Professional Staffing client mix consists of 71% GCCs, 20% IT customers within enterprises, and 9% to 10% from IT services.

lab.quote: So, hopefully by Q1 and most likely by end of Q2, we should be able to have full confirmation from clients and accordingly, we will take that impact.

call_memory.quote: So, hopefully by Q1 and most likely by end of Q2, we should be able to have full confirmation from clients and accordingly, we will take that impact.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management expects full confirmation from clients regarding the Labor Code impact most likely by end of Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: So, the portfolio diversification in the last 7-8 years and the strength of the quality of customers that we work with, backed up by the essential services, nature of the work we have done, we continue to close Middle East for this financial year and this quarter at a high point of more than 2,200 contractors.

call_memory.quote: So, the portfolio diversification in the last 7-8 years and the strength of the quality of customers that we work with, backed up by the essential services, nature of the work we have done, we continue to close Middle East for this financial year and this quarter at a high point of more than 2,200 contractors.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Overseas business contractors in Middle East closed at more than 2,200 at the end of the year.

lab.quote: Two years back, there was only 30% demand in AI data, cloud, cyber security space. Now, this contributes almost 60% of total demand where we have better build rate and better margin.

call_memory.quote: Two years back, there was only 30% demand in AI data, cloud, cyber security space. Now, this contributes almost 60% of total demand where we have better build rate and better margin.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Demand in emerging technology skills like AI, data, cloud, and cybersecurity contributes almost 60% of total Professional Staffing demand, up from 30% two years ago.

call_points.text: Net cash position stands at ₹271 crore with zero gross debt, enabling strong dividend payouts.
FY26 adjusted PAT rose 10% to ₹230 Cr with net cash reaching ₹271 Cr and ROE at 20%.
Q4FY26 EBITDA grew 28% YoY to ₹86 Cr, reaching an EBITDA margin of 2.2%.
Dividend policy post-demerger targets returning ~75% of free cash flow over a cumulative three-year block.
High-margin portfolio (Professional Staffing and Overseas Business) contributed 50% of FY26 operating EBITDA.
In Professional Staffing, GCCs drove 67% of segment revenue and 71% of headcount.
General Staffing added 59 new contracts in Q4FY26 and 281 contracts across FY26.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The appeal is pending before the CIT(A) for FY 2017-18. The said appeal is pending for hearing.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Income Tax Department (Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax)
tax_litigation.status: The said appeal was filed against the rectification order passed u/s 154 of the Act on 6th February, 2026. In the rectification order, the MAT credit for the year was disallowed basis an assessment order passed for earlier year FY 2016-17. As per the rectification order total demand amounting to INR 1,79,67,456 was raised.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The allegations primarily pertain to passing on the input tax credit to the insurance company i.e. Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Ltd. without supply on manpower services in violation of Section 16, 31 & 35 of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Rule 36, 46 & 56 of the CGST Rules, 2017 read with Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Commissioner of CGST and CEX. (Appeals-III), Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received an Order-in-Appeal dated 30.06.2026 on 20.07.2026. An appeal shall be filed with Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal in this regard.

timeline.summary: Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited and HWIC Asia Fund (Class A Shares) declared no new encumbrances on Quess Corp shares under SEBI Takeover Regulations on 02 April 2026.
Quess Corp received an income tax refund of ₹155.11 Cr for FY2025 from the Income Tax Department.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,892.45 Cr (+6.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹64.14 Cr (against a loss of ₹95.49 Cr a year earlier).
Quess Corp published its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation detailing FY26 EBITDA growth of 19% to ₹312 Cr and adopting a 75% FCF shareholder return policy.
Kundan K. Lal, CFO of Quess Corp Limited, uploaded the analyst call recording on May 5, 2026, via the company’s investor relations website.
Quess Corp reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹3,892 Cr and proposed a total dividend of ₹6 per share.
Quess Corp received an exchange clarification request regarding the format of the Statement of Impact of Audit Qualifications for Q4 FY26.
Quess Corp Limited’s Board declared a ₹3 special interim dividend per share (30% of face value) on May 4, 2026, payable by May 21, 2026, with TDS deductions applied.
Quess Corp announced postal ballot voting results approving QSOP 2026 and the appointment of Lohit Bhatia as Group CEO.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,181.69 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹81.9 Cr.
Quess Corp reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹4,396 Cr and PAT of ₹75 Cr, with headcount crossing 500k and an interim dividend of ₹5 per share declared.
